verdict.rationale: Proton Pass has no documented public REST/HTTP API in the evidence. It does ship an official CLI, documented in a first-party blog post, that offers programmatic create/read/update/delete on vaults and on items such as passwords, notes, cards and SSH keys, and secret retrieval for scripts and CI/CD pipelines. That gives an AI agent a scriptable control surface, but only through a command-line wrapper rather than an API. Missing for 10: a documented public API with reference docs, API auth/token documentation, machine-readable docs (llms.txt and docs-md both return 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of programmatic use.
